caption: 80 Maple Ave LLC v. Harleysville Insurance Co. of New Jersey
citation_line: 80 Maple Ave LLC v. Harleysville Insurance Co. of New Jersey, No. 2:25-cv-02878, ECF No. 18 (D.N.J. June 25, 2026)
headnote_district_ruling: Declined to sever and stay a first-party insurance bad-faith claim because the pleaded coverage and bad-faith theories substantially overlapped and separate discovery would create duplication and recurring boundary disputes.
qualification_rationale: Rejects a categorical approach to the frequently requested sequencing of coverage and bad-faith discovery under New Jersey law.
appellate_posture_note: Non-dispositive case-management order; no substantive appellate review identified.
subject_screen_exclusion_reason: Severance and discovery-sequencing decision that leaves coverage and bad-faith liability unresolved.
